gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same a18/a50 direct-combination failure: a18 requires Lagrange-polynomial control on supp(ν), while a50 supplies control only on supp(μ), with no assumed relation allowing the latter to establish the former. It also identifies the resulting failure of the general ν-independent rate and gives a support-matching repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The theorem combines estimates taken over different supports, so the a50 estimate cannot establish the supp(ν) quantity required by a18; consequently the asserted general rate in a10 is unproved.

component_coverage.gold_component: The a18 estimate concerns Lagrange norms on supp(ν), whereas a50 estimates them on supp(μ), and the absent support relation invalidates their direct combination and the asserted general rate.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly identifies the two incompatible support domains, states that the direct combination requires an unassumed support equality, records the failure of the general rate, and proposes either matching supports or otherwise supplying the missing norm transfer.
